description: Use this first when a user wants a Canadian mortgage renewal, extra-payment, break-or-stay or debt-consolidation comparison but has not yet given the key figures. From the facts already supplied, returns the missing ones in priority order and up to three questions to ask (balance, rate, remaining amortization, term, switching costs, lender-quoted penalty). Flags a request to borrow additional cash (cash-out refinance) as unsupported. Do not use when the figures are already supplied: call the matching calculator. Does not calculate, rank, check qualification or search rates.

facts.description: Facts the user has already given; any may be left out. Other keys are ignored, and the result says so.

amortizationExtended.description: True when the new mortgage would run over a longer amortization than the current one has left, for example stretching back to 30 years. Adds a warning that a lower payment from a longer amortization is not a lower cost.

origin.description: "user" when the user stated it (the default).

amortizationMonths.description: Remaining amortization in months, never years: 25 years is 300. Never inferred from the payment. A figure: {state:"known",value:"412000",origin:"user"}, or the plain value ("412000", 412000, "4.89"), or {state:"unknown"}. A leading $, a trailing % and thousands commas ("412,000") are removed. Unknown is never treated as zero.
